look_here_first: Low annual bladderpod with dense yellow flower clusters, stellate-scaly hairs, and round to obovoid inflated capsules on spreading pedicels.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Brassicaceae bladderpod group: 4-petaled yellow flowers, stellate hairs common, and inflated silicles/capsules; habit, hair density, pedicel posture, and fruit shape are important for ID.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: yellow to orange dense terminal racemes

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: fruiting pedicels spreading to nearly horizontal

lookalikes.differences: Low, compact, densely flowered annual. Compared with P. gracilis, it is shorter and denser; compared with P. engelmannii, it is annual rather than perennial.
